ProjectControlsV1Update.description:
Replaces the project's whole override. The flat fields map onto the
units of the response's ``override``:

- ``zero_data_retention`` → ``override.zero_data_retention``
- ``ignored_vendors``, ``allowed_vendors``, ``vendor_routing_preference`` →
  ``override.vendors``
- ``ignored_regions``, ``allowed_regions`` → ``override.regions``

Sending any field of a unit overrides the whole unit: the unit's fields you
leave out become ``[]``, not the organization's values. A unit with no field
sent inherits from the organization. A list sent as ``null`` counts as sent,
the same as ``[]``. ``zero_data_retention: null`` is the same as omitting it.

allowed_models.description: INTELLIGENT only. Kept in the order sent. A model listed twice is a 422. Models with no capability tier are dropped, so the response can list fewer. Used only when strategy is sent.

allowed_providers.description: INTELLIGENT only, optional. Not stored: responses rebuild it from allowed_models. If sent non-empty, it must name the same providers as allowed_models (order and repeats don't matter), or the request fails with 422. Checked only when strategy is sent.
allowed_providers.title: Allowed Providers

axis.description: INTELLIGENT only. Omitted or null means COST. Used only when strategy is sent.

description.description: null keeps the current description. Send "" to clear it.

priority_order.description: PRIORITY only. The priority values are kept as sent; responses list the entries sorted by priority. A model listed twice is a 422. Used only when strategy is sent.
priority_order.title: Priority Order

slug.description: Renames the slug. null keeps the current one.

strategy.description: Send with its fields to replace the routing. Omitted or null leaves the routing as it is, and allowed_providers, allowed_models, priority_order and axis are ignored.
